title: Modeling Software Quality in Virtual Reality Applications from User Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2308.06783v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) applications couple software behavior with head-mounted displays, body movement, spatial interaction, and multimodal feedback. Consequently, familiar software-quality problems can have distinct consequences in VR, yet empirical knowledge of the quality concerns expressed by VR users remains fragmented.   We analyze 1,656,968 public reviews of 28,745 VR applications across seven app stores. Our semiautomatic workflow uses five unsupervised methods to generate candidate aspects and multi-round human open and focused coding to construct and refine a hierarchical model of user-perceived VR software quality. The resulting model comprises 12 quality attributes and ten influencing factors. It distinguishes conventional attributes whose consequences change in VR from attributes closely tied to VR, including multisensory perception, user-friendly interaction mechanisms, immersivity, and comfort and safety. translated_title: 从用户反馈中建模虚拟现实应用中的软件质量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2308.06783v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：虚拟现实（VR）应用将软件行为与头戴式显示器、身体运动、空间交互和多模态反馈相结合。因此，常见的软件质量问题在VR中可能产生不同的后果，然而关于VR用户所表达的质量关注点的实证知识仍然零散。我们分析了七个应用商店中28,745个VR应用的1,656,968条公开评论。我们的半自动工作流程使用五种无监督方法来生成候选方面，并通过多轮人工开放和聚焦编码来构建和完善用户感知的VR软件质量层次模型。最终模型包含12个质量属性和十个影响因素。它区分了在VR中后果发生变化的常规属性与紧密关联VR的属性，包括多感官感知、用户友好交互机制、沉浸感以及舒适性和安全性。影响因素...
tldr: 本文通过分析大量VR应用的用户评论，构建了一个包含12个质量属性和十个影响因素的层次模型，揭示了VR特有的质量维度（如多感官感知、沉浸感、舒适与安全）与常规属性在VR中的差异化影响。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes extensive user reviews of VR apps to construct a hierarchical model with 12 quality attributes and ten influencing factors, highlighting VR-specific dimensions (e.g., multisensory perception, immersivity, comfort/safety) and how conventional attributes manifest differently in VR.
